diagnosis.title: Assessment
diagnosis.q1: What is your current business registration status?
diagnosis.q2: Have you completed a cosmetic responsible sales report?
diagnosis.q3: Do you own a Class 03 (cosmetics) trademark?
diagnosis.q4: Have you established your brand identity (BI)?
diagnosis.q5: Do you have product development experience?
diagnosis.q6: Have you decided on a product category?
diagnosis.q7: Do you have your own formula?
diagnosis.q8: Have you selected target ingredients or a concept?
diagnosis.q9: Is your product design (container & packaging) ready?
diagnosis.q10: What is your expected initial production quantity?
diagnosis.q11: Do you have an estimated target cost range?
diagnosis.q12: Do you have a desired delivery timeline?
diagnosis.q13: Do you have raw material and packaging suppliers?
diagnosis.q14: Do you have quality control (QC) standards?
diagnosis.q15: Do you have a dedicated project team?
diagnosis.q17: Do you have licensing or certification experience?
diagnosis.q18: Do you have sales channels established?
diagnosis.q19: Do you have plans for overseas export?
diagnosis.q20: What is your marketing & promotion capability?
